facts.fact: The World Bank implementation status report for the Economic and Financial Governance Project sets a PDO indicator on the percentage of tax returns filed and paid on time via ITAS, at 0 as of 9 January 2026 against a 70% target for December 2029, so the system is not yet in use.
The World Bank project record for the US$20m Djibouti Economic and Financial Governance Project says it includes tax administration system modernization and revenue administration digitalization.
